datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Madagascar on a monthly basis (February, June, October 2017). The data represents spatial assessments of acute food insecurity phases mapped to administrative units, with scenario variations and assistance requirements documented. The IPC classifications serve as post-event or ongoing impact assessments of food security status.
